notes.text: Diogenes the Cynic, also known as Diogenes of Sinope, was an ancient Greek philosopher during the period of Classical Greece, and one of the founders of Cynicism.
Diogenes is remembered as a philosopher connected with Türkiye.
Diogenes's recorded life dates place this profile around -404--322.
Diogenes is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
Diogenes's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Türkiye historical setting.
